name: stable_bytes on a UTF-8 boundary that is not a grapheme-cluster boundary
description: Every rejected offset below is a valid UTF-8 code-point boundary, which is why a UTF-8-only check is insufficient. Clusters: [0,3) e+U+0301 - [3,4) space - [4,22) family ZWJ sequence - [22,23) space - [23,31) regional-indicator pair - [31,32) space - [32,39) keycap #+VS16+U+20E3. Legal offsets are exactly the cluster boundaries 0, 3, 4, 22, 23, 31, 32 and 39.

checks.reason: between 'e' and its combining acute U+0301
between U+1F468 and the ZWJ that binds it to the next emoji
cluster boundary after the ZWJ sequence
between the two regional indicators of the flag
between '#' and the variation selector U+FE0F
between U+FE0F and the combining enclosing keycap U+20E3
